## Data wrangling 
extract ratings and embedding-IDs from the study (only needs to be excuted once: copy with edit from Study2.rmd)

```{r}
hum <- fread("../data/main/human.csv")

llm1 <- fread("../data/main/llm.csv")
llm1[, `icecream2` := NULL]

llm2 <- fread("../data/main/llm2.csv")

# Base R
llm <- rbind(llm1, llm2)

llm.df <- llm %>%
   clean_names() %>%       # fixes duplicates & makes snake_case
   select(-matches("_Response")) %>%
  mutate(experiment = "LLM") %>%
  slice(-c(1:2))

hum.df <- hum %>%
  clean_names() %>%
   select(-matches("_fr_")) %>%
   mutate(experiment = "Human") %>%
   slice(-c(1:2))



main.df <- bind_rows(llm.df, hum.df) %>%
     filter(progress == 100,
             distribution_channel != "preview") %>%
   #turn empty string into NA
   mutate(across(everything(), ~ na_if(., "")))

main.df <- subset(
  main.df,
  is.na(compromised) |
    !(
      (compromised == "Yes") |
      (!is.na(q_recaptcha_score) & q_recaptcha_score <= 0.5) |
      (!is.na(icecream) & icecream == "Salt and Pepper")
    )
)


# # Create Basic Wide Dataframe with all ratings
exp1.df<-main.df %>%
  mutate(participant = 1:n()) %>%
  select(x1_s1_t_first_click:x117_s9_cf5_6,
         x120_s5_t_first_click:x223_s5_cf5_6,
         scenario_id_1, scenario_id_2, scenario_id_3,
         option_id_1, option_id_2, option_id_3,
         participant,
         experiment, response_id,
         condition)%>%
  select(-contains("last_click"), -contains("click_count")) %>%
  gather(category, response, -participant,-experiment, -response_id,
         -condition, -option_id_1, -option_id_2, -option_id_3,
         -scenario_id_1, -scenario_id_2, -scenario_id_3) %>%
  filter(response != "") %>%
  mutate(exp_condition = case_when(
    str_detect(condition, "1") ~ "judgment last",
    str_detect(condition, "2") ~ "judgment first")) %>%
  mutate(scenario = case_when(
    str_detect(category, "s1_") ~ "scenario 1",
    str_detect(category, "s2_") ~ "scenario 2",
    str_detect(category, "s3_") ~ "scenario 3",
    str_detect(category, "s4_") ~ "scenario 4",
    str_detect(category, "s5_") ~ "scenario 5",
    str_detect(category, "s6_") ~ "scenario 6",
    str_detect(category, "s7_") ~ "scenario 7",
    str_detect(category, "s8_") ~ "scenario 8",
    str_detect(category, "s9_") ~ "scenario 9")) %>%
  mutate(responsetype = case_when(
    str_detect(category, "a1_4") ~ "prob_resp_1",
    str_detect(category, "a1_5") ~ "moral_resp_1",
    str_detect(category, "a1_6")  ~ "normal_resp_1",
    str_detect(category, "a2_4") ~ "prob_resp_2",
    str_detect(category, "a2_5") ~ "moral_resp_2",
    str_detect(category, "a2_6")  ~ "normal_resp_2",
    str_detect(category, "a3_4") ~ "prob_resp_3",
    str_detect(category, "a3_5") ~ "moral_resp_3",
    str_detect(category, "a3_6")  ~ "normal_resp_3",
    str_detect(category, "a4_4") ~ "prob_resp_4",
    str_detect(category, "a4_5") ~ "moral_resp_4",
    str_detect(category, "a4_6")  ~ "normal_resp_4",
    str_detect(category, "a5_4") ~ "prob_resp_5",
    str_detect(category, "a5_5") ~ "moral_resp_5",
    str_detect(category, "a5_6")  ~ "normal_resp_5",
    str_detect(category, "ar_4") ~ "prob_resp_act",
    str_detect(category, "ar_5") ~ "moral_resp_act",
    str_detect(category, "ar_6")  ~ "normal_resp_act",
    str_detect(category, "b_")  ~ "blame",
    str_detect(category, "cf1") ~ "cf_1",
    str_detect(category, "cf2") ~ "cf_2",
    str_detect(category, "cf3") ~ "cf_3",
    str_detect(category, "cf4") ~ "cf_4",
    str_detect(category, "cf5") ~ "cf_5",
    str_detect(category, "first_click") ~ "first_click",
    str_detect(category, "page_submit") ~ "page_submit"
  )) %>%
  select(-condition, -category) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = responsetype,
              values_from = response,
              values_fn = first)

write_rds(exp1.df, "../data/exp1_df.rds")
```


## Merge ratings and clusterlabels
```{r, echo=FALSE}
df <- read_csv("./output/original/distances_and_clusters.csv") %>% mutate(response_number = as.integer(response_number)) %>% mutate(response_id = as.character(response_id))

ratings <- readRDS("../data/exp1_df.rds") %>% 
  select(scenario_id_1 , scenario_id_2, scenario_id_3, 
         option_id_1, option_id_2, option_id_3,
         scenario ,blame,
         prob_resp_1, moral_resp_1, normal_resp_1, cf_1,
         prob_resp_2, moral_resp_2, normal_resp_2, cf_2,
         prob_resp_3, moral_resp_3, normal_resp_3, cf_3,
         prob_resp_4, moral_resp_4, normal_resp_4, cf_4, 
         prob_resp_5, moral_resp_5, normal_resp_5, cf_5
         ) %>% 
  mutate(scenario_id_1 = as.integer(scenario_id_1),
         scenario_id_2 = as.integer(scenario_id_2),
         scenario_id_3 = as.integer(scenario_id_3),
         scenario = as.integer(str_extract(scenario, "\\d+"))) %>%
  mutate(
    option_id = case_when(
      scenario == scenario_id_1 ~ option_id_1,
      scenario == scenario_id_2 ~ option_id_2,
      scenario == scenario_id_3 ~ option_id_3,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(-scenario_id_1 , -scenario_id_2, -scenario_id_3, 
         -option_id_1, -option_id_2, -option_id_3)

ratings_long <- ratings %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ sub("^cf_", "cf_resp_", .x),
    starts_with("cf_")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(prob|moral|normal|cf)_resp_[1-5]$"),
    names_to = c("measure", "response_number"),
    names_pattern = "(prob|moral|normal|cf)_resp_([1-5])",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(response_number = as.integer(response_number)) %>% 
  rename(response_id = option_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = measure,
    values_from = value,
    values_fn   = first
  ) %>%
  arrange(response_id, scenario, response_number) %>%
  select(response_id, scenario, response_number, blame,
         prob, moral, normal, cf)


df <- df %>% left_join(ratings_long,
    by = c("response_id", "scenario", "response_number")
  )


df<- df %>%
  mutate(
    # cut the label string after the first . 
    cluster_kmeans_label = str_split_fixed(cluster_kmeans_label, "\\.", 2)[,1],
    blame = as.numeric(blame),
    prob = as.numeric(prob),
    moral = as.numeric(moral),
    normal = as.numeric(normal),
    value = rowMeans(across(c(prob, moral, normal)), na.rm = TRUE),
    cf = as.numeric(cf),
    type = forcats::fct_recode(
      type,
      Action = "action",
      Human  = "human",
      LLM    = "llm"
    )) %>% 
  filter(type != "Action")

```


```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
SCENARIO <- 3
var <- "value"

plot_df <- df %>%
  filter(
    scenario == SCENARIO,
    !is.na(cluster_kmeans),
    !is.na(type),
    type != "Action"
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster_kmeans_label, type) %>%
  summarise(
    n     = n(),
    value = mean(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
    cluster_kmeans = {
      x <- cluster_kmeans[!is.na(cluster_kmeans)]
      if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else x[1]
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  arrange(desc(n), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_df %>% filter(type == "Human") %>% select(cluster_kmeans,cluster_kmeans_label) %>% arrange(cluster_kmeans) 


label_map_hum <- c(
  "0"  = "Give ticket to Ted; skip concert",
  "1"  = "Skip the concert",
  "2"  = "Check for a digital ticket",
  "3"  = "Go home to retrieve the ticket",
  "4"  = "Buy a new ticket",
  "5"  = "Give Ted your ticket",
  "6"  = "Go home",
  "7"  = "Wait for Ted",
  "8"  = "Look for ticket resale options",
  "9"  = "Contact the venue",
  "10" = "Try to sneak in",
  "11" = "Go back together with Ted"
)

plot_df %>% filter(type == "LLM") %>% select(cluster_kmeans,cluster_kmeans_label) %>% arrange(cluster_kmeans) 

label_map_llm <- c(
  "0"  = "Wait together; negotiate entry",
  "1" = "Request ticket reissue",
  "2"  = "Call someone to deliver ticket",
  "3"  = "Show online ticket copy at entry",
  "4"  = "Ask around for spare ticket",
  "5"  = "Check if tickets still available",
  "6"  = "Ask staff: ID plus purchase proof",
  "7"  = "Use rideshare to fetch ticket",
  "8"  = "Buy another ticket at venue",
  "9"  = "Call box office for reprint",
  "10" = "Check phone/email for digital ticket",
  "11" = "Wait nearby; bring ticket at break"
)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    labels_short = dplyr::case_when(
      type == "LLM" ~ dplyr::recode(
        as.character(cluster_kmeans),
        !!!label_map_llm,
        .default = as.character(cluster_kmeans_label)
      ),
      TRUE ~ dplyr::recode(
        as.character(cluster_kmeans),
        !!!label_map_hum,
        .default = as.character(cluster_kmeans_label)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    labels_short = reorder_within(labels_short, -n, type)
  )


p <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = labels_short, y = n, fill = value)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9, colour = "black") +   # remove alpha here
  facet_wrap(~ type, scales = "free_x", drop = TRUE) +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", alpha = 0.7) +   # alpha in the scale
  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Number of responses",
    fill = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  myTheme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 16),
    legend.position = "left",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85", colour = "grey40"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "plain", size = 16)
  )

p

out_dir <- file.path("plots", "type_clustering", var)
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    
ggsave(
  sprintf(
    "plots/type_clustering/%s/cluster_scenario%d.png",
    var, SCENARIO
    ),
  plot = p,
  width =14, height = 6, dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE
  )
```
